messages:
anna: Quick thought — we should try splitting the golden set into two buckets: `latency-focused` (short prompts, high-frequency patterns) and `quality-focused` (longer, edge-case probes). Goal: reduce total bench cost for initial admits while still protecting quality-sensitive flows.
kevin: how do you define which inputs go to which bucket? auto heuristics or manual tags? :thinking_face:
marta: +1 to split. We can start with simple heuristics: token length, perplexity estimate, and request rate. low-perplexity & high-rate -> latency bucket. low-rate/long/rare tokens -> quality.
samir: Flag: compatibility checks need to run against both buckets, but with different thresholds. latency bucket can tolerate slightly higher generation variance as long as latency and token error rate are within SLO. quality bucket needs stricter semantic regression checks.
kai: observability note — we must tag telemetry so we can attribute regressions to bucket membership. otherwise rollouts will be noisy. also consider storing a compact fingerprint per example for quick diffing.
anna: config sketch (start point):
```yaml
golden_buckets:
  - name: latency-focused
    selector:
      max_tokens: 64
      min_rps: 10
      max_perplexity: 30
    checks:
      - latency_p50 < 80ms
      - token_error_rate < 0.5%
  - name: quality-focused
    selector:
      min_tokens: 65
      min_rps: 0
    checks:
      - semantic_similarity >= 0.92
      - hallucination_rate < 0.8%
```
kevin: rollout plan idea — run latency bucket on fast-path canary (small % of incoming models) and run full quality bucket as background async eval for first 24h. If quality fails, immediate halt on release. Can we automate rollback? :arrow_backward:
marta: fallback policy should map to model variants: if quantized variant fails quality checks, fallback to full-precision variant for that customer class. We should ensure routing policy supports per-customer override.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary job started for branch `golden-bucket-split` — job id 8342, dataset=golden_v2. Status: queued.
samir: I'm worried about edge-case coverage — splitting reduces duplicates but may hide regressions that only appear when mixing patterns. Suggest adding a small mixed-bucket sample (10% of golden) that mirrors production distribution.
kai: agree with samir. Also add latency/quality cross-check matrix in console so SRE and product can see tradeoffs per model.
anna: ok action items: (1) samir + marta prototype selector + mixed sample, (2) kevin wires canary + rollback automation, (3) kai adds telemetry tags and dashboard wires. I'll PR config and tests by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: I can pair with ops on rollback automation tomorrow morning.
marta: will produce initial heuristic script and a small notebook for visualization.
ops-bot: ci: tests passing for `golden-bucket-split` branch — 24/24.
anna: thanks — will follow up in sync. :rocket:
